notes: GEL-VARIANT DIMENSIONS: The official US Allergan Natrelle Product Catalog lists one shared dimension row per size covering all three Inspira gel variants (e.g., table 'STYLES SCM, SSM, & SRM' - Cohesive/SoftTouch/Responsive share identical volume, diameter, projection for the same catalog size). Dimensions are therefore gel-independent for smooth round Inspira; only the gel fill differs (Responsive < SoftTouch < Highly Cohesive in firmness). STYLE CODES confirmed by official DFU L034rev12 (rxabbvie.com) and catalog: Responsive = SRL/SRLP/SRM/SRF/SRX (smooth), TRL/TRLP/TRM/TRF/TRX (BIOCELL textured); SoftTouch = SSL/SSLP/SSM/SSF/SSX (smooth), TSL/TSLP/TSM/TSF/TSX (textured); Cohesive = SCL/SCLP/SCM/SCF/SCX (smooth), TCL/TCLP/TCM/TCF/TCX (textured). All rows extracted here are the SMOOTH versions. TEXTURED variants have slightly different dims at some sizes (documented in the same catalog, e.g., textured TRL low profile is wider/flatter than smooth SRL: TRL-110 10.00/1.9 vs SRL-110 10.00/2.0; TRF-770 16.00/6.2 vs SRF-770 15.50/6.0). UNITS: Allergan US documents already publish dimensions in cm - no mm conversion was needed. Diameter = base width for round implants. TASK FLAGSHIP EXAMPLES DO NOT EXIST AS STATED: there is no 'SoftTouch Moderate 350 cc' (SSM ladder is ...345 [12.50/4.2], 360 [12.75/4.2], 375...) and no 'Full SRF 400 cc' (SRF ladder is ...385 [12.25/5.0], 415 [12.50/5.1]...; 400 cc exists in SRX [11.50/5.8], SRLP [14.00/3.6] and MM-410400). Nearest documented sizes were cross-checked instead and all matched a second source. 410 ANATOMICALS: 12-style matrix (3 heights x 4 projections), 116 catalog sizes, all extracted from the official US Allergan catalog (width/height/projection in cm; catalog volume in cc = grams as labeled). FDA recall Z-2452-2019 (PMA P040046) confirms the full catalog-number ladders. Two extra FM sizes (FM-410155: 9.5/10.0/3.4; FM-410180: 10.0/10.5/3.6 per MilfordMD reproduction) appear in the FDA recall but not in the 2017 catalog table - included only in crosscheck notes, not in the FM rows (kept to the official catalog). Natrelle 410 was recalled/withdrawn from the US market July 2019 (BIOCELL textured); tables are historical record. CROSS-CHECK SUMMARY: >=3 flagship values verified against independent second sources - SSF-520 13.25/5.5 (Allergan portfolio PDF, match), SCF-415 12.50/5.1 (match), SCF-650 14.50/5.9 (match), SRF-415 12.50/5.1 and full Responsive tables (Allergan 2015 sales tool, match), 410MF all 13 rows (peer-reviewed reproduction of INAMED table, match), 410MM and 410FM (distributor/clinic reproductions, match). One conflict found and documented: MilfordMD's 410ML table erroneously duplicates LL dims - official catalog values used. GAPS: (1) No official Allergan document with per-size dimensions was found on the live natrelle.com/allergan.com/abbvie.com sites (current DFUs give only style/size RANGES); the per-size tables come from official Allergan catalog/sales-tool PDFs preserved on third-party hosts (URLs given) plus the official Allergan UK 2016 catalog. (2) FDA PMA P020056/P040046 public documents (SSED, DFU) contain ranges only, not per-size dimensions. (3) Textured (T-code) round Inspira full tables exist in the same catalog but were not extracted (out of scope).
